verdicts.reason: The repo claim holds: F-4.next is [F-5-6, F-4-R, F-5-7, F-5-13] and only H-2 offers F-5-14. Meanwhile H-2.next now sends every H-2 holder to F-4 ('in Korea at any time since 2026.02.12'), and F-5-14's own needs already count `stay in [H-2, F-4]`, so the data itself treats F-4 time as counting. The KIS 동포 guide includes people who changed to F-4. I could not re-fetch that guide this session, but the quote matches the repo's own stay rule. The proposed note is narrower than the rule: it reads as if all 4 years had to be on H-2, when continuous service with the same employer counts across the change to F-4. As a bare entry, the edge also shows 'later' on NONE > F-4 (simulated), where someone who came straight to F-4 can never qualify. F-5-14 has no visadocs list, which is the existing, known exception the H-2 edge already has.
verdicts.correctedFix:
# data/visamap.yaml, visas.F-4.next: add
    - to: F-5-14
      note: {en: 'If you changed from H-2 to F-4 and have worked 4+ years in total (H-2 and F-4 time together) for the same employer in manufacturing, farming or livestock, fishing, care or housekeeping, with a technical qualification or the required wage.'}   # ru, uz, uz-cyrl must be translated
      needs: {korean: true, stay: {years: 4, in: [H-2]}}
# The move-level needs is optional but recommended: it requires H-2 on the path, so NONE > F-4 is blocked, H-2 > F-4 is 'later' and F-4 as the current visa is 'maybe' (simulated). H-2 can only be the starting visa (in-degree 0), so the 4 does not shorten anything. Without it, the edge inherits F-5-14's {korean, stay 4 in [H-2, F-4]} and shows on every F-4 path.
